''SCC'' | founded = {{Start date and age|df=yes|1964|6|19}} | stadium = [[Kooi Stadion]] | capacity = 15,000 | chairman = | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Johan Plat]] | league = {{Dutch football updater|Cambuur}} | season = {{Dutch football updater|Cambuur2}} | position = {{Dutch football updater|Cambuur3}} | current = 2026–27 SC Cambuur season | pattern_la1 = _cambuur2627h | pattern_b1 = _cambuur2627h | pattern_ra1 = _cambuur2627h | pattern_sh1 = _cambuur2627h | pattern_so1 = _3_stripes_blue | leftarm1 = FFEE00 | body1 = FFEE00 | rightarm1 = FFEE00 | shorts1 = 0000FF | socks1 = FFEE00 | pattern_la2 = _cambuur2627a | pattern_b2 = _cambuur2627a | pattern_ra2 = _cambuur2627a | pattern_sh2 = _cambuur2627a | pattern_so2 = _adidasonblackl | leftarm2 = 000000 | body2 = 888888 | rightarm2 = 000000 | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 888888 | website = {{official URL}} }} '''Sportclub Cambuur''', most often styled '''SC Cambuur''' ({{IPA|nl|ɛsˈseː ˈkɑmbyːr}}) and sometimes '''Cambuur Leeuwarden''', is a Dutch professional [[Association football|football]] club in [[Leeuwarden]], the capital of [[Friesland]]. Founded on 19 June 1964, the team compete in the [[Eredivisie]], the top tier of [[Dutch football league system|Dutch football]], following promotion from the [[Eerste Divisie]] in the [[2025–26 Eerste Divisie|2025–26 season]]. Since August 2024, they have played their home games at the 15,000‑seat [[Kooi Stadion]], a purpose‑built stadium that replaced [[Cambuur Stadion]].{{cite web|url=https://www.thestadiumbusiness.com/2024/08/19/sc-cambuur-opens-up-new-stadium/|title=SC Cambuur opens up new stadium|website=thestadiumbusiness.com|date=19 August 2024}} Cambuur play in yellow shirts and blue shorts, colours drawn from the coat of arms of the [[Cammingha]] family, whose heraldic lions also feature on the club crest. Organised as a member‑owned association, the club enjoys strong regional backing and contests the "Friese Derby" against neighbouring [[SC Heerenveen|sc Heerenveen]]. The club have won the second-tier [[Eerste Divisie]] three times ([[1991–92 Eerste Divisie|1991–92]], [[2012–13 Eerste Divisie|2012–13]] and [[2020–21 Eerste Divisie|2020–21]]) and spent a total of nine seasons in the top-tier [[Eredivisie]]. Away from the pitch Cambuur operate an accredited youth academy and the Cambuur Foundation, which runs grassroots sport and social‑inclusion programmes throughout Friesland.{{cite web |last1=Willis |first1=Craig |last2=Hughes |first2=Will |last3=Bober |first3=Sergiusz |title=ECMI Minorities Blog. National and Linguistic Minorities in the Context of Professional Football across Europe: Five Examples from Non-kin State Situations. |url=https://www.ecmi.de/infochannel/detail/ecmi-minorities-blognational-and-linguistic-minorities-in-the-context-of-professional-football-across-europe-five-examples-from-non-kin-state-situations |website=ECMI |access-date=27 March 2023}}"}}
